title: Clustered Observations: CR2 Bands and Gene Screening
text: Twelve donors, observed time point u, contribute 80 cells. Cells belong one two latent components; marker shifts component probability, response depends signal opposite signs two components. donor effect enters every cell donor.
code: set.seed(1) n_donor <- 12L cells <- 80L donor <- rep(seq_len(n_donor), each = cells) u <- ((seq_len(n_donor) - 1) / (n_donor - 1))[donor] n <- length(donor) marker <- rnorm(n) component <- ifelse(rbinom(n, 1, plogis(-0.3 + 1.8 * marker + 0.8 * u)) == 1, 1L, 2L) signal <- rnorm(n) library_size <- exp(rnorm(n, 0, 0.3)) eta <- log(library_size) +   ifelse(component == 1, 1 + 0.3 * u + 0.4 * signal, 0.2 - 0.5 * u - 0.2 * signal) +   rnorm(n_donor, 0, 0.1)[donor] dat <- data.frame(   y = rnbinom(n, size = 6, mu = exp(eta)),   log_library = log(library_size),   u = u, donor = donor, marker = marker, signal = signal,   noise1 = rnorm(n), noise2 = rnorm(n) )

what: Fit the model and refine it
title: Clustered Observations: CR2 Bands and Gene Screening
text: null model screen contains library-size offset experts component marker gating. Fitting one grid point per donor time point keeps every grid point supported data. theta ridge stabilises dispersion cells carry component. vcmoe_refine() continues local EM tight tolerance. default stopping rule relative, many cells can stop local maximum; inference often finds sandwich bread positive definite.
code: fit <- vcmoe_fit(   y ~ offset(log_library) | marker,   data = dat, u = "u", k = 2L, family = "negative-binomial",   bandwidth = 0.3, u_grid = sort(unique(dat$u)),   control = list(seed = 3, n_starts = 2, maxit = 300,                  negbin_theta_ridge = 0.05, negbin_theta_target = 8) ) fit <- vcmoe_refine(fit, tol = 1e-9, maxit = 2000) head(vcmoe_diagnostics(fit)[, c("u", "converged", "stop_reason", "objective_delta", "refined")]) #>                      u converged stop_reason objective_delta refined #> 0           0.00000000      TRUE   tolerance    6.369944e-07    TRUE #> 0.090909091 0.09090909      TRUE   tolerance    1.194968e-06    TRUE #> 0.18181818  0.18181818      TRUE   tolerance    1.560205e-06    TRUE #> 0.27272727  0.27272727      TRUE   tolerance    1.624012e-06    TRUE #> 0.36363636  0.36363636      TRUE   tolerance    1.599456e-06    TRUE #> 0.45454545  0.45454545      TRUE   tolerance    1.664505e-06    TRUE

title: Joint-Path EM
text: Runtime grows approximately number observations, grid points, EM iterations, starts. default, joint-path EM rejects 100 grid points grid--observation ratio 0.2. Set control$allow_dense_u_grid = TRUE explicitly accepting cost. grid close unique(u) also produces warning approaches one local model per observation. start converges control$maxit, fit returned explicit warning finite interim estimates can still inspected. Treat estimates provisional review joint_path_trace inference.

title: Joint-Path EM
text: Analytic confidence bands use observed local-likelihood sandwich plug-evaluated fitted coefficient arrays. joint-path fits local-curvature approximation, covariance complete finite-grid shared-path estimator. returned metadata states shared-path, label-selection, finite-grid cross-grid responsibility uncertainty included reports score imbalance. Parametric bootstrap refits, GLRT full null fits, reduced fits, bandwidth-selection refits preserve selected engine. joint-path GLRT, constant-coefficient null uses projection update: constrained local paths replaced every M-step average grid points (equal weights default; null_projection = "sample_weighted" weights grid points nearest-grid observation counts). projected estimator, generic constrained MLE. likelihood ratio compares observation-level mixture log-likelihoods, every coefficient path evaluated observation’s u linear interpolation. null fit fails, beats full fit fitted objective, blocks test; null fit stops iteration limit gives p-value warning. GLRT calibration defaults "none"; request analytic approximation engine-preserving parametric bootstrap calibration explicitly. default first joint-path start posterior mixture experts without u dependence, keeps component labels consistent along u. Always inspect convergence, component sizes, label ambiguity, null-fit diagnostics interpreting inference either engine.
code: band <- vcmoe_confband(fit, strict = FALSE)  boot <- vcmoe_bootstrap(   fit,   data = sim$data,   B = 200,   seed = 23 )  test <- vcmoe_glrt(   fit,   data = sim$data,   test = "coefficient",   coefficient_set = "expert",   component = 1,   term = "z1",   calibration = "none" )  selection <- vcmoe_select_bandwidth(   y ~ z1 | x1,   data = sim$data,   u = "u",   family = "gaussian",   bandwidth_grid = c(0.30, 0.40, 0.50),   folds = 3,   u_grid = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),   engine = "joint_path_em" )

title: VCMoE
text: VCMoE represents observation coming one k latent components. component (c), expert model describes response distribution, gating model describes probability belonging component. continuous coordinate u, gating model form: expert mean modeled family-specific component functions. Gaussian response, expert model form: current implementation uses Epanechnikov kernel local fitting scaled local-linear basis. public interface supports k = 2:10 diagnostic outputs convergence, label alignment, component overlap, inference quality.

title: Refine a local-grid VCMoE fit — vcmoe_refine
text: Continues local EM selected grid points fitted solution, tighter tolerance iterations. relative stopping rule vcmoe_fit() (tol = 1e-5 default) corresponds large absolute change local objective sample large, fit can stop local maximum reached; bread used vcmoe_confband() often positive definite. Refining fixes without refitting scratch. refined grid point keeps labels original fit; refinement change reported, applied silently.

title: VCMoE 0.3.0
text: local-grid EM now stops penalized local objective ascends (loglik - penalty), unpenalized log-likelihood, can stop flat stretch objective still climbs. Starts met stopping rule preferred, among one highest penalized objective kept; none met , best finite start kept converged = FALSE. loglik still reports unpenalized log-likelihood. Default fits can therefore differ slightly 0.2.0. New vcmoe_refine() continues local EM fitted solution tighter tolerance, keeping labels. default relative tol = 1e-5 can stop well local maximum large samples; refining inference usually makes sandwich bread positive definite. vcmoe_diagnostics() reports per grid point stop reason, last objective change, selected start, whether unconverged start reached higher objective, label-alignment overrides refinement. Global label alignment relabels grid point confident match neighbour flagged (alignment_override) warning. Grid-parallel fitting: control$grid_subset, grid_seed, grid_warm_start grid_init_locals, vcmoe_merge_grid_fits() vcmoe_grid_neighbor_inits(). Merged parts reproduce serial fit exactly per-grid seeds without warm starts. Merges can switch label = "greedy". Negative-Binomial theta ridges scaled kernel mass grid point (negbin_theta_penalty_mass = "kernel"), fitted theta solves estimating equation sandwich differentiates. Objects 0.2.0 read original rule; strict inference fits theta ridge blocked request refit. Known-label fits control$fixed_membership. Joint-path fits start default mixture experts without u dependence (joint_path_global_start = TRUE), keeps component labels consistent along u. Joint-path fits can therefore differ 0.2.0.

title: VCMoE 0.3.0
text: vcmoe_glrt() now compares observation-level mixture log-likelihoods, coefficient path evaluated observation’s u. 0.2.0 local-grid statistic summed grid-point local likelihoods, counts observation 1 / (grid spacing) times; analytic p-values far small, results computed recomputed. control$lambda_type = "fit_objective" reproduces 0.2.0 scale. Analytic calibration counts coefficient functions constrained null: default C_const now 1 (2). strict = FALSE default. Optimizer failures still block test; null fit stopped iteration limit gives p-value warning null_converged = FALSE. Joint-path null fits project constrained paths onto equal-weight grid average default (control$null_projection = "uniform"), setting used validation analytic calibration; null_projection = "sample_weighted" restores 0.2.0 weighting nearest-grid observation counts. Bootstrap refits follow tested component, k >= 3 components gating contrast. Draws whose null optimizer failed whose null beats full refit excluded; bootstrap_counts reports requested, successful excluded draws. GLRT reduced-fit metadata changed: criterion-matching entry removed settings, theory_status, calibration_status statistic_criterion take new values describe statistic used. Joint-path confidence-band metadata uses "joint_path_observed_local_likelihood_plugin".

title: VCMoE 0.3.0
text: vcmoe_confband(fit, cluster = id) gives cluster-robust intervals local-grid fits: CR2 Bell-McCaffrey degrees freedom default (CR0, CR1 CR3 available), finite-grid simultaneous bands studentized wild cluster bootstrap Webb weights. Diagnostics report active effective clusters, degrees freedom block reasons per grid point. control$path_tests = TRUE adds zero constancy path tests, control$path_sets bands sub-paths. New vcmoe_gene_screen() screens candidate covariates expert associations Negative-Binomial fits, CR2 studentization, shared wild cluster bootstrap, optional gating profiling strong markers Benjamini-Hochberg min-p adjustment full candidate set. predict() bounds Negative-Binomial theta [negbin_theta_min, negbin_theta_max] interpolating, likelihood , stored unbounded value longer gives NaN predictions. Strict inference now blocks grid points converge. Negative-Binomial eta-bound checks use observations positive kernel weight grid point.

title: VCMoE 0.2.0
text: Adds stable single-response joint-path EM vcmoe_fit(..., engine = "joint_path_em"). Keeps engine = "local_grid_em" default preserves 0.1.0 local-grid numerical path engine omitted. Adds dense-grid cost guardrails, nearest-grid observation assignment, joint-path convergence traces, optional progress logging.

title: VCMoE 0.2.0
text: Makes analytic confidence bands available common fitted-object interface engines. Joint-path bands identify local-likelihood sandwich plug-scope expose score-imbalance diagnostics. Makes parametric bootstrap refits bandwidth selection engine-aware. Adds sample-weighted projected joint-path constrained-null fitting GLRT vcmoe_fit_reduced() retaining established local-grid BFGS null optimizer. Joint-path GLRT uses sample-level nearest-grid likelihood contributions blocks failed nonconverged null fits. Changes GLRT calibration default "none". statistic available without reference distribution; analytic Epanechnikov calibration explicit approximation, parametric bootstrap calibration engine-preserving. Adds criterion, projection, constrained-MLE, calibration, theory-status metadata GLRT results. Analytic confidence bands now state whether covariance target matches fitted estimator shared-path label uncertainties excluded.
